propositions: ADR 0035 §(d) must specify the concrete backend interface with four pinned decisions: canonical model, diff/apply ownership, role Protocols, and RemoteRef type.

The backend interface should define five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) behind a unified Backend facade with optional capability Protocols.
Rebar's local ticket must be the canonical model with no separate CanonicalTicket; adapters translate vendor↔local via existing mappers.
RemoteRef type (vendor, instance, remote_id) must replace hardcoded vendor literals and bare remote IDs in apply_inbound_records.py.
The revised ADR must document three leak-fixes: ADF-sizing removal from differ, lossy-status/parent rules into vendor adapter, and deduplicated value-maps/link-constants.
Status and Decision/Consequences sections must reference epic bbf1 for current phase and defer first real second backend implementation to epic be74.
